fields.iso2: ISO_A2_EH (the -EH variant, which unlike ISO_A2 codes France, Norway, Kosovo and Taiwan)
fields.name: ADMIN

processing: Antarctica and features without a 2-letter ISO code dropped; geometry simplified with a 0.05-degree tolerance (invisible at world scale).
note: ISO_A2_EH gives the same code to a country and its dependencies. All features are kept so the choropleths paint every polygon; load_world() anchors each code on its largest polygon across features, so a flow-map arc to AU lands on the mainland and not on Ashmore Reef.
